components.name: Tarot Carousel
components.description: A fanned deck of tarot-style cards in 3D. Stepping through turns the active card face-up mid-flight while the fan re-deals around it.

components.name: Paint Spread Wordmark
components.description: A blueprint wordmark that floods with wet paint as the cursor passes, bleeding outward from the stroke with drips and a drying stain behind it.

components.name: Image Queue
components.description: A stack of cards you can throw away by dragging, or step through with arrows. Each release drops the card and pulls the queue forward.

components.name: Sphere Album
components.description: A sphere of image cards on a Fibonacci lattice. Scroll spins it, drag tumbles it in any direction with inertia, click opens the card's link.

components.name: Spherical Gallery
components.description: A room of cards wrapped around the viewer. Drag to look around, hover a card to bring it forward.

components.name: ASCII Particle Text
components.description: Headline text sampled into a field of ASCII characters that pile, assemble and scatter, scrambling and recoiling from the cursor.

components.name: Snap Deck
components.description: An infinite card deck that snaps to a focal anchor and interpolates between row and column layouts, blooming the focused card back to full colour.

components.name: Helical Scroll Gallery
components.description: Cards ride a 3D helix driven by scroll position, rendered in WebGL with depth fog and focal scaling.

components.name: Scroll Assemble Image
components.description: An image shatters into tiles that reassemble as you scroll, across seven assembly styles and seven arrival orders.

components.name: Floating Arc Card Slider
components.description: Two infinite card rows riding an inverted parabola, with drag momentum, hover drift and a cursor-tracking spotlight border.

components.name: Curved Card Marquee
components.description: A card river bent along a real curve — arc, valley, wave, tilt or cross — running as a ticker or as a pinned scroll section.

components.name: Coverflow Carousel
components.description: 3D coverflow-style image carousel with keyboard and dot navigation.

components.name: Curved Carousel
components.description: 3D curved carousel with drag momentum and auto-play rotation.
